# Factor I O

> Factor I O Co., Ltd. is a Thailand-based infrastructure engineering and governed enterprise AI consultancy led by Thanat Manasakool. Nearly 20 years in enterprise infrastructure, enabling Thailand's leading SI partners.

The practice leads with infrastructure architecture, migration, private AI and SI technical enablement. Light is the reusable governance and execution foundation for AI workflows adapted to customers' existing systems, identities, data and approval processes. Models reason; trusted controls decide whether execution is allowed. No claim of vendor endorsement or of deterministic LLM reasoning is made.

## Consulting website

- [English homepage](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/): Infrastructure expertise and governed enterprise AI.
- [Services](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/services/): Infrastructure/SI engagements; Enterprise AI Workflow Engineering, Governed Agent Operations, Service & Dependency Intelligence, Custom Enterprise AI Solution; recurring controlled optimization.
- [Platform](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/platform/): Light governance, model placement, structured control versus flexible payload, optional Nutanix inference integration without endorsement.
- [Governance](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/governance/): Explicit identity/scope/approval and a local illustrative demo, not a connected production service.
- [How We Work](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/how-we-work/): Understand, Integrate, Govern, Operate & Improve.
- [About](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/about/): Principal-led infrastructure engineering and SI enablement.
- [Contact](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/contact/): Prepare a complete local email draft. No automatic submission, storage or inference. Sending via the visitor's email app is a separate explicit action; ordinary email correspondence may be retained.

Thai equivalents use /th/ with matching page paths and explicit authored content. Thai is publicly accessible but noindex pending native-language review; it is not yet approved language copy. Historical services.html remains a separate noindex, unlinked deck, not the current services page.

## Open source

- [light-tools](https://studio.factor-io.com/light-tools.html): Open-source MCP server that replaces the built-in file and shell tools used by AI coding agents with token-efficient versions. One Go binary, stdio, no daemon or database. Five tools: light_file, light_bash, light_ssh, light_scp, light_ops. Installs via `npm install --global @factor-i-o/light-tools`. GPL-3.0-or-later.
- [light-tools source](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools): Canonical repository, README, releases and checksums.
- [light-tools reference](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.md): Exact tool and verb semantics — argument repair, continuation cursors, output spill, snapshots, confinement.
- [light-tools agent setup](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools/blob/main/AGENT-SETUP.md): Full registration procedure for MCP-capable coding agents.
- [light-tools security model](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools/blob/main/SECURITY.md): What `allowed_roots` does and does not protect. Read before treating confinement as a security boundary.

## Tools

- [Local AI savings calculator](https://studio.factor-io.com/tco-calculator.html): Start with complete, labelled single-server examples for code reading, document triage or test drafting. No demand entry or AI conversation required. One fixed 96 GB workstation, local/premium responsibilities, baseline and residual API bills, full electricity, hardware capex, net savings and payback are priced from cited sources with exact arithmetic. Example throughput and quality are assumptions, not measurements; overflow goes to the original premium request. Losses and payback beyond the horizon are shown honestly. Source/engine amounts are exact USD, screen amounts THB; starter JSON exports retain exact USD and FX provenance. Secondary custom sizing preserves self-hosted/model-API/rented-GPU comparisons and peak-demand sizing. Startup atomically refreshes complete OpenRouter pricing and Frankfurter FX with dated fallback data. Spotify's cited result is about mean bulk-read Claude token reduction using Gemini workers, not total billing reduction or a local-hardware benchmark. Normative spec: docs/tco-calculator/SPEC.md. Zero build step, no analytics or tracking.
- [Optional AI advisor](https://studio.factor-io.com/tco-assistant.html): A dedicated page carrying a captured calculator scenario through an opaque tab-local identifier. At most four bounded scenario/proposal records stay in sessionStorage for two hours; reset clears owned records. Transcript (latest 40 messages) and eight complete exchanges stay in page memory only and disappear on reload. No inference on navigation. Send or Ask explicitly contacts Factor IO's endpoint; preparing/copying a credential-free request for a local gateway does not send it. Guided answers and AI proposals remain inert until the calculator expands every dependent setting, shows the full diff and receives explicit Apply. Control conflicts preserve edits; price drift re-quotes current data. Apply consumes once and recomputes; a grounded blueprint specification requires a fresh applied snapshot. AI prose never supplies calculator arithmetic or provenance. The downstream processor is MiniMax-M3; no browser credential or endpoint field exists.

## Separate products

- [Blink](https://blink.factor-io.com/): Privacy protection for Android, built for the threat standing next to you. Entirely on-device, zero data collection. Live on Android.
- [Blink privacy policy](https://blink.factor-io.com/privacy-policy): Blink's own policy, separate from the studio-wide statement.
- CatCountdown: A countdown app with personality — nine cats, fifteen categories. Launching soon on Google Play and iOS.

## About

- [Factor I O](https://studio.factor-io.com/): Infrastructure-led consulting, approach, services and contact; full English homepage canonical to /en/.
- [Privacy statement](https://studio.factor-io.com/privacy.html): No advertising, tracking, analytics or accounts. The calculator automatically GETs public OpenRouter pricing and Frankfurter FX without calculator context. Scenario/proposal handoffs persist only in tab-local sessionStorage with two-hour expiry; conversation history is in-memory only. Send or Ask POSTs captured planning context and retained exchanges to ai.factor-io.com, which holds the MiniMax credential server-side and forwards the request — Factor I O DOES proxy calculator AI requests. Neither request nor response is stored by the proxy; service logs contain only route, status, model, byte counts and duration. No browser API key exists.
- [Thanat Manasakool on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thanat-manasakool-3101905a/): Founder & Principal Engineer. Nearly 20 years in enterprise infrastructure, with experience as an Ecosystem Solutions Architect for Red Hat and Nutanix, delivering architecture guidance and technical enablement to Thailand's leading SI partners.
- [Thanat Manasakool on GitHub](https://github.com/icediceice): Maintainer of light-tools.
